w10_T4_003014: A workshop had 202 solar panels in the store and built 67 more. Every panel is made up of 7 cells. During testing 8 of those cells cracked and were thrown away. A box on the shelf holds 34 spare cells of exactly the same kind. Each cell weighs 9 grams, and the workshop records its weights in grams rather than in kilograms. What is the total weight, in grams, of the cells?
w10_T4_003023: On Monday morning a florist had 131 bunches of tulips and sold 80 of them before noon. Every bunch still in the shop holds 6 tulips. In the afternoon 267 tulips were used for a wedding. In the evening a grower delivered another 15 tulips. All of the tulips left in the shop were then shared equally among its 6 window vases. How many tulips went into one vase?
w10_T4_003024: Kenji stacked 9 boxes with 169 tiles in each box. Every tile in the yard is scored into 3 smaller squares. A builder then carried off 1104 squares, more than Kenji's helper Mei had ever moved in a day. Mei added 54 squares she found on an old pallet. Half of the yard is under cover. How many squares are in the yard?
w10_T4_003025: On Saturday morning a market stall had 126 crates of eggs and sold 111 of them before noon. Every crate still on the stall holds 4 trays. In the afternoon a farm delivered another 60 trays of the same size. Each tray holds 8 eggs. In the evening a neighbour brought 29 loose eggs to the stall. How many eggs did the stall have?
w10_T4_003027: Ade had 27 rolls of wire and gave 18 of them to his cousin Bea, who ended up with more rolls than he kept. Every roll Ade kept holds 9 metres of wire. A neighbour donated another 69 metres to him. Bea then doubled what Ade was holding by matching it metre for metre. Each metre can be cut into 2 short lengths, and every short length sells for 9 pence. The workshop bench is 4 metres long. How many pence is Ade's wire worth?
w10_T4_003030: A club had 238 chairs and sold 88 of them at auction. A school borrowed 97 chairs and never brought them back. A grant then let the club triple the number of chairs it still had. A fire officer later condemned 147 of the chairs as unsafe. Every chair that is left will be hired out 7 times this year. The clubhouse itself was built in 1962. How many hires will that come to?
w10_T4_003031: Ivo counted 171 nails in every tin at the depot. Each toolbox holds 9 tins, each van carries 5 toolboxes, and the firm runs 7 identical vans. His colleague Petra found 28 loose nails on the floor, then 79 more in a bucket and 15 on the bench, though her finds were tiny next to Ivo's stock. Half of the vans were washed on Friday. How many nails does the firm have?
w10_T4_003036: Ana filled 3 sacks with 146 garlic bulbs in each sack. Every bulb in those sacks was split into 7 cloves. She planted 558 cloves in the top field. She gave 167 cloves to her brother Ben, far fewer than she still had herself. A market stall then bought another 579 cloves. How many cloves does Ana have left?
w10_T4_003038: A school kitchen had 21 crates of apples and bought 15 more. A second store room holds exactly the same number of crates, so the kitchen now has 2 identical stores. Then 7 crates were found rotten and thrown out. Each crate holds 4 bags, and every bag holds 9 apples. The kitchen counts its fruit in single apples rather than in crates. How many apples does the kitchen have?
w10_T4_003039: A brickyard made 71 blocks on each of 6 days. Of those blocks, 89 cracked while drying and were thrown away. Every good block was then cut into 2 equal pieces. A demolition down the road provided another 24 pieces of exactly the same size. Each piece weighs 8 kilograms. What is the total weight, in kilograms, of the pieces at the yard?
w10_T4_003042: Dara packed 25 boxes of biscuits, and her colleague Femi added 7 more, fewer than Dara had packed. Every box holds 5 bags, each bag holds 5 packets, and each packet holds 3 biscuits. A wedding order then took 569 biscuits away. The bakery van is 6 years old. How many biscuits are left?
w10_T4_003043: On Monday morning an ice cream parlour had 234 tubs in the freezer, and a delivery added 64 more before noon. Every tub in the freezer gives 3 scoops. During the afternoon 249 scoops were sold to customers. In the evening a supplier dropped off enough for another 39 scoops. The parlour counts its stock in single scoops rather than in tubs. How many scoops does the parlour have?
w10_T4_003045: On Saturday morning a stall set out 5 boxes with 15 candles in each box. Before lunch 49 of the candles were sold. In the afternoon 5 more were knocked over and broken. Each candle still on the stall burns for 6 hours, and half of the stall stood in shade all day. How many hours of burning time are left on the stall?
w10_T4_003048: A library had 218 magazines and recycled 22 that were damaged. Every magazine it kept was scanned into 3 separate files. Those files were shared equally among the library's 3 branch servers. A library card costs 4 pounds a year. Each file on the first server is kept in 2 copies for safety. How many file copies are on the first server?
w10_T4_003052: Ola had 46 crates of bottles in the yard, Bruno brought 21 more, the smallest load of the day, and a depot sent over another 56 crates. A forklift damaged 8 crates, which were taken away. Every crate left in the yard holds 6 packs, and each pack holds 9 bottles. Half of the yard is under a canopy. A driver then added 35 loose bottles to the count. How many bottles are in the yard?
w10_T4_003059: Hilda planted 57 bulbs in each of her 8 flower beds. Every bulb sent up 3 flowers in the spring. A late frost killed 905 of those flowers. Her neighbour Josef, whose garden had far fewer flowers than Hilda's, gave her 26 cut stems. A florist added another 74 stems to her display. How many flowers does Hilda have?
w10_T4_003063: Nia and Owen shared 34 sheets of card equally, and Nia carried her half to the art room. A teacher gave Nia 16 more sheets, so she then held more than Owen did. She spoiled 9 of her sheets with wet paint. A parent donated 64 sheets to her pile. Every sheet Nia has can be cut into 6 name cards. How many name cards can Nia make?
w10_T4_003065: Salma had 35 photo frames, and her friend Tobias gave her 31 more, almost as many as she already owned. Each frame holds 4 photographs. Half of the frames are made of wood. She also keeps 10 loose photographs in an envelope. She then posted 61 photographs to her cousin. How many photographs does Salma have?
w10_T4_003067: A depot shared 230 sacks equally among its 5 vans, and Ravi took the share loaded into his van. Every sack in his van holds 3 boxes. His colleague Lena added 64 boxes of her own, fewer than Ravi was already carrying. He delivered 106 boxes on the morning round, and 18 boxes came back refused. A shop then took 59 boxes off him. The depot counts its loads in single boxes rather than in sacks. How many boxes are in Ravi's van?
w10_T4_003068: A mill wove 118 metres of cloth on each of 9 days, and it records its cloth in metres rather than in yards. A shop bought 935 metres of it. A customer then returned 9 metres that were the wrong colour. All the cloth that remained was split equally between the mill's 2 workshops. The mill has 14 looms in the main hall. In the first workshop every metre was cut into 6 strips, and each strip makes 3 wristbands. How many wristbands can the first workshop make?
w10_T4_003069: On Monday morning Dina had 80 bags of cement on site, and 13 of them were spoiled by rain. Before lunch a lorry brought 60 more bags, and her foreman Aziz ordered 75 extra, a bigger delivery than the first one. In the afternoon the crew used 152 bags on the foundations. Every bag still on site will make 3 buckets of mortar. How many buckets of mortar can be made?
w10_T4_003075: A cafe had 56 bags of coffee beans and used 28 of them during the week. It sold 19 bags to a neighbouring shop. A roaster then delivered 13 more bags. Every bag makes 5 pots of coffee, and the cafe measures its drinks in pots rather than in litres. How many pots of coffee can the cafe make?
w10_T4_003076: On Monday morning a pool had 57 swimmers booked into each of its 3 lanes. That same booking was repeated on each of the 7 days of the holiday week. Across the afternoon sessions 55 extra swimmers turned up. In the evenings another 71 swimmers joined in. The pool writes its session lengths in minutes rather than in hours. How many swimmers used the pool that week?
w10_T4_003090: A factory puts 122 screws into every packet. Each tray holds 8 packets, each box holds 7 trays, and each pallet holds 8 boxes. The shipment that left on Friday was made up of 9 identical pallets, and half of it was bound for the docks. How many screws were in the shipment?
w10_T4_003093: A gallery printed 159 posters in each of its 5 print runs. Of those posters, 9 came out damaged and were binned. A member of staff found 47 posters from an older run and added them to the stack. The gallery has 14 rooms open to the public. A weekend sale sold 643 posters, and half of the buyers were students. Framing each poster that is left costs 6 dollars, and the gallery quotes its prices in dollars rather than in cents. How much would it cost, in dollars, to frame all the posters that remain?
